verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a discrete GPU, but none of the first-party docs in the pack document a power envelope (TGP/TDP), sustained-power behavior, or any efficiency claim for the RTX 5090. The only power data is independent. TechPowerUp measures about 575 W, near the 600 W connector limit. Phoronix and llama.cpp tests put performance-per-watt merely on par with the 4080/4090, sometimes significantly lower, and one reader notes the 4080 Super has better perf/watt. That is measurement of the card, not evidence that it delivers power-efficient sustained workloads.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, sustained workloads are power-efficient on this part — documented power envelopes with independent performance-per-watt testing
